On Sundays we roast. Join us for double egg Yorkshire puddings, lashings of gravy and perfectly roasted meats, as well as seasonal vegetarian roasts vegan. Book a table, or pop in. Christmas in Woolwich Christmas at The Guard House is all about good food, great drinks and getting together with your favourite people. From festive feasting and flowing drinks to plenty of Christmas cheer, we’ve got everything you need for a celebration to remember. Sunday Roasts in SE London Day of rest? Not for us. Not on your nelly. Our kitchen team will be cooking up succulent joints of meat, baking massive Yorkies, and crisping up roasties all day long. So, you can kick-back, relax and enjoy a proper pub Sunday roast. host a roast Cosy up with a Winter Cocktail Discover seasonal favourites like our rich, bittersweet Fig Negroni and sparkling Pomegranate Fizz, alongside classics including the Espresso Martini and Old Fashioned. The menu Private Dining in SE London Looking to host a large dinner party? Let us take care of the planning, and privately hire one of our private dining spaces. Choose from the Aviary, Conservatory or the Mess. Private Hire Dine with us Our kitchen is open every day of the week and is fronted by our fantastic Head chef Marcin. We celebrate the best of British food by only ever using the best seasonal ingredients which are delivered daily throughout the year. Sunday plans? Sorted. Load up on crispy roasties, tender British meat, giant Yorkshires, seasonal sides and gravy by the jug. Christmas Day is our kind of day — a table full of your favourite people, a delicious festive feast and nowhere else you need to be. Whether you’re joining us for a big Christmas meal or popping in for a festive drink, we’ll be ready to celebrate with you across SE London. And when NYE rolls around, we’ll be raising a glass and seeing out the year in style Check out our menus Winter Cocktails Come in from the cold and settle in with something delicious. Our brand-new Winter Cocktail menu has landed, made for cosy afternoons, crisp evenings and long nights spent lingering over a drink or two.
